title: Detailed violin
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='100' height='100'>
  <!-- Violin body - warm amber/gold -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='20' ry='26' fill='#D4942A'/>
  <!-- Upper bout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='15' ry='14' fill='#E0A83A'/>
  <!-- Waist curves -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='16' ry='8' fill='#C8861E'/>
  <!-- Lower bout highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='18' ry='16' fill='#DC9E30'/>
  <!-- F holes - dark but lit purple -->
  <path d='M40 52 Q38 58 40 64' stroke='#7040A0' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 52 Q62 58 60 64' stroke='#7040A0' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- F hole dots -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='52' r='1.2' fill='#7040A0'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='64' r='1.2' fill='#7040A0'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='52' r='1.2' fill='#7040A0'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='64' r='1.2' fill='#7040A0'/>
  <!-- Bridge - light wood -->
  <rect x='43' y='58' width='14' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#F0D080'/>
  <rect x='44' y='56' width='2' height='5' fill='#F0D080'/>
  <rect x='54' y='56' width='2' height='5' fill='#F0D080'/>
  <!-- Tailpiece -->
  <path d='M46 70 L50 78 L54 70 Z' fill='#B87A20'/>
  <!-- Chin rest -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='72' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#A06018'/>
  <!-- Neck - dark brown -->
  <rect x='47' y='18' width='6' height='24' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- Fingerboard - dark but visible -->
  <rect x='47.5' y='20' width='5' height='22' fill='#3A2040'/>
  <!-- Scroll/pegbox -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='15' r='6' fill='#A87030'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='15' r='3.5' fill='#C89240'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='15' r='1.5' fill='#E0B060'/>
  <!-- Pegs -->
  <rect x='42' y='13' width='8' height='2' rx='1' fill='#D4A050'/>
  <rect x='42' y='17' width='8' height='2' rx='1' fill='#D4A050'/>
  <rect x='50' y='11' width='2' height='8' rx='1' fill='#D4A050' transform='rotate(90 51 15)'/>
  <!-- Strings -->
  <line x1='49' y1='20' x2='49' y2='56' stroke='#F0E0A0' stroke-width='0.7'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='20' x2='50' y2='56' stroke='#F0E0A0' stroke-width='0.7'/>
  <line x1='51' y1='20' x2='51' y2='56' stroke='#F0E0A0' stroke-width='0.7'/>
  <!-- String highlights -->
  <line x1='49' y1='56' x2='49' y2='76' stroke='#E0D090' stroke-width='0.5' opacity='0.6'/>
  <line x1='51' y1='56' x2='51' y2='76' stroke='#E0D090' stroke-width='0.5' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Endpin -->
  <rect x='49' y='80' width='2' height='4' rx='0.5' fill='#C0A060'/>
  <!-- Purfling detail line around body edge -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='18' ry='24' fill='none' stroke='#B87A20' stroke-width='0.6' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Bow crossing -->
  <line x1='22' y1='35' x2='78' y2='72' stroke='#E8C870' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='22' y1='35' x2='22' y2='30' stroke='#C87030' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='78' y1='72' x2='78' y2='67' stroke='#C87030' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Bow hair -->
  <line x1='24' y1='35' x2='76' y2='71' stroke='#F8F0D0' stroke-width='1'/>
</svg>
